title: Member Services Training Notes: Payments That Make Up the Down Payment Paid on a Payment Arrangement
content:
**Member services training — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): which payments make up the down payment paid**

**The rule.** Which payments make up the down payment paid follows the collection standing of the member's Electric Service by Rate Schedule account:

- where the service account carries an outstanding disconnect notice and no returned payment was posted in the twelve months ending on the acceptance day, every payment posted to the service account in the month ending on the acceptance day counts;
- where it carries an outstanding disconnect notice and a returned payment was posted in those twelve months, only the payments posted in that month other than checks and electronic checks count;
- where no disconnect notice is outstanding, the down payment paid is the latest payment posted on or after the offer date.

**Questions answered in training**

*What is a check for this rule?* A check paid at an office or sent by mail, and an online electronic check. Card, cash, money order, kiosk, bank draft and agency payments are not checks.

*A notice is outstanding and the member made three payments in the month. Do all three count?* All three count where no returned payment was posted in the twelve months; where one was, only those that were not checks or electronic checks count.

*No notice is outstanding and the member paid twice after the offer. Which payment is the down payment paid?* Only the latest payment, where it posted on or after the offer date.

**Hypothetical month ending on the acceptance day:** $40.00 at a payment kiosk, then $75.00 by mailed check, both after the offer date.

| Standing | Down payment paid |
|---|---|
| notice outstanding, no return in 12 months | $115.00 |
| notice outstanding, a return in 12 months | $40.00 |
| no notice outstanding | $75.00, the latest payment |
